onboarding_title_1: All Your Medical Services in One Place
onboarding_subtitle_1: No need to search in multiple places! Book doctors, lab tests, radiology, and medical consultations easily and quickly from where you are.
onboarding_subtitle_2: Browse the list of doctors and services, choose what suits you best, and schedule your appointment with one click—no calls or long waits.
onboarding_subtitle_3: Keep a digital medical record including your past appointments, lab results, and doctors' recommendations, with notifications to continuously monitor your health.
